title: Load instructions by path and task instead of making every run read ~40k tokens
problem: A ventures run is told to read CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded), prompt.md, prompts/goals.md, its sub-prompt, portfolio/DIRECTION.md, AGENTS.md, PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md and land-your-work.md: about 41k tokens before it starts, held in context and re-read (cached) on every request. DIRECTION.md alone is ~15k tokens, says goals.md wins where they differ, and is mostly notes on earlier sessions' mistakes. CLAUDE.md spends ~150 of its ~480 lines on the pre-merge CI checklist that only a merging run needs. Estimated share of a run's API-equivalent cost spent carrying these files: ~45% for a short (~20-request) run, ~15% for a long (~50-request) run, assuming standard relative prices (cache read 0.1x, 1h cache write 2x, output 5x base input). The owner does not see this as a problem in itself (2026-10-16); the payoff is cheaper short runs and less overlap between rule sets.
evidence: chars/4 on origin/main bc4dcc3b05: CLAUDE.md 6.5k, AGENTS.md 2.5k, portfolio/DIRECTION.md 15.0k, PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK.md 6.5k, prompts/goals.md 5.9k, prompt.md 1.2k, prompts/ventures/prompt-1.md 1.7k, .github/prompts/land-your-work.md 2.0k tokens
CLAUDE.md line 15: 'Read portfolio/DIRECTION.md and AGENTS.md first.'
change: Claude Code loads a subdirectory's CLAUDE.md only when the session reads files there, and a skill only when invoked. (1) Drop 'read DIRECTION.md and AGENTS.md first' from CLAUDE.md; make DIRECTION.md a reference and move its dated history to docs/history/. (2) Move the pre-merge checklist and CI-reading rules into a skill (.claude/skills/verify-and-merge/) that land-your-work.md invokes. (3) Move the product rules into ventures/CLAUDE.md and hosting rules into portfolio/hosting/, the way research/CLAUDE.md already works. (4) Keep root CLAUDE.md to what every run needs: public-repo safety, land-your-work, routing. Nothing is deleted; every rule keeps one home. Check checklist_coverage.py and any test that greps CLAUDE.md before moving text.
metric: Tokens of instruction text a ventures run and a research run must read before starting (chars/4), and median api_equivalent_usd per run for each track
baseline: ventures ~41k tokens; research ~17k tokens; median api_equivalent_usd over the 8 measured runs on 2026-10-16: $0.53
source: Owner review of repo standards in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-16 (cost share is an estimate from 8 runs with usage recorded; see problem)
